verdict.rationale: Kick documents an AI workflow where live report data lands in Google Sheets so Gemini/Claude/ChatGPT can read and reason over it, which could support a question like "can we afford X?", but this runs through a spreadsheet bridge, not a genuine public ledger API — probes show openapi/swagger endpoints all 404, and the only live MCP endpoint found serves GitBook documentation search, not ledger data or account actions. Missing for 10: a documented public API or account-scoped MCP server exposing live ledger data directly to agents, and any evidence of natural-language affordability Q&A being answered from it.
